doc_summary: `native_screen_render_post`, the point of `ScreenEvent.Render.Post`: a native mod draws over the open screen after it and its tooltips, given its id, title, container panel and slot count (`NativeScreenView`). Bundles that use it need "hooks": @API:screen_render_post@.
